caption:
USWNT beats El Salvador 8-0 to qualify for 2027 Women's World Cup

Emma Hayes · Sport

The United States led 7-0 at half-time on Friday and has a place at the 2028 Olympics. Kennedy Wesley gave the United States the lead inside eight minutes, CBS Sports reported. Emma Hayes' side had not played a competitive match since the Olympic gold medal game in August 2024. The team played only friendlies in the two years between.

Reported by The Guardian; CBS Sports; ESPN.
